x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"time_and_material_notification\":{\"creation\":[95861],\"customer_signed\":[95861],\"company_signed\":[95861],\"closed\":[95861],\"group_equipment_totals_by\":\"per_ticket\",\"notify_dl_on_customer_signed\":true,\"notify_dl_on_company_signed\":true,\"notify_dl_on_creation\":true,\"notify_dl_on_closed\":true,\"group_labor_totals_by\":\"per_ticket\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/time_and_material_notifications?run_configurable_validations=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
